# Priyanka Das — AI Product Manager & Business Architect

> Priyanka Das is an AI Product Manager and Business Architect based in Stockholm, Sweden (Swedish citizen), with ~9 years across banking, public sector, insurance, transport and e-commerce. She specialises in AI product management, AI evals, AI agents, multi-agentic systems, next-best-action (NBA) AI decisioning, Pega GenAI, and explainable AI. She is open to AI Product Manager, Product Owner and AI Builder roles in Stockholm or remote worldwide, available immediately.
